{{Quote|Private Krieger can't stop shaking. Gialto thinks he shot his husband. This Dread Master stuff, man&hellip;|Sergeant Trila|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Gialto]] was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to a [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. When Gialto was stranded in the wastes of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oricon]] during the [[Dread War]], he experienced hallucinations that he shot his husband. Gialto was eventually rescued, but remained mentally traumatized in the immediate aftermath.
